name: Tamralinga
description: An island east of Jambhudweep, drawn as an outline with nothing inside it.
notes: Drawn on the render as a dotted shape containing only a question mark -- the cartographer knowing something is there and not what. Kept as `unknown` territory rather than given content. Ground rather than building: it is here before anyone names it and after they stop. Ground rather than building: it is here before anyone names it and after they stop.
